remote_desktop.description: This environment supports a shared desktop and browser. In on-demand mode, use the desktop's NodeREPL js tool for your first action if it is available. A valid call such as js({"code":"1 + 1"}) starts the runtime. Connecting an authorized desktop viewer also starts it. Tool discovery and status polling leave it idle. To show the desktop in the Codex side panel, call open_in_codex with the cloud-desktop target if offered.
